name.description: Name of the Field Type or Method.

declaredNativeRequirement.description: Name of the {@Link Action.Requirement} if this field or method was declared on a native remix.

title:
Ref value to FieldType or Method.

This has the string representation of the parent type name and the field or method separated by a hash mark:
"Duration#fromString". This is the same format used for documentation references.

In addition, if #declaredNativeRequirement exists, that will be appended after a space:
"Duration#fromString js-client".
